tasks.label: buildplugin
args:
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
repo = os.getcwd()
pluginpack = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(repo, '..', '..', 'pluginpack.py'))
permissions = os.path.join(repo, 'permissions_root')
if not os.path.isfile(pluginpack):
    raise SystemExit(f'pluginpack.py was not found: {pluginpack}')
if not os.path.isdir(permissions):
    raise SystemExit(f'permissions_root folder does not exist: {permissions}')
subprocess.run([sys.executable, pluginpack, '--input', repo, '--with-version', '--mask', r'(?i)(^|[\\/])(permissions_root([\\/]|$)|readme\.md$)'], check=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='staff_changes_data_access_') as temp:
    shutil.copytree(permissions, os.path.join(temp, 'permissions_root'))
    ET.register_namespace('', 'http://plugin.powerschool.pearson.com')
    ET.register_namespace('xsi', 'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance')
    tree = ET.parse(os.path.join(repo, 'plugin.xml'))
    root = tree.getroot()
    root.set('name', root.get('name') + ' - Data Access')
    root.set('description', 'Data Access for ' + root.get('description'))
    tree.write(os.path.join(temp, 'plugin.xml'), encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, pluginpack, '--input', temp, '--with-version'], check=True)
